title: Hoshino Ichika — A Direct Compliment〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What do you think we should get for her...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, Hona's practicing really hard for her reading event...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She might be feeling tired since she's not used to acting. So, what if we got her something that she'll find encouraging?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right...
Something encouraging...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Honami just replied back.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Where is she practicing?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
The park.
Oh, she even sent a picture. Take a look.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, look at that!
She and Nene are doing a “Let's do this!” pose!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I have to think that they're both really motivated.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It sounds like she's been practicing every day after school since she was asked to be the storyteller.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It really is like her to work so hard like this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, that means we gotta support those two by buying something nice for them!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. I hope we find something they'll like.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I know...
Her favorite thing might do the trick, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, since this is Honami we're talking about, we should probably get...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, I know the answer!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ It has to be...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho, Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: Apple pies!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Those are a must.
I've never seen Honami look unhappy while having an apple pie.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right. Seems like a sure bet.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I can picture it now!
Hona's smiling face when she finds out that we got her apple pies!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No need to picture it, we'll see it soon.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, while we're on the subject...
I remember her talking about some particular ones recently.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, the ones from the confectionary shop in this mall! She said they started selling them not too long ago!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She talked about them pretty passionately. She said she's really excited about trying them since she hasn't had them yet.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which means they'd make the perfect gift.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go get some!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now, what would go well with them?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm... Well...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Since they're practicing telling a story, they might want something that helps their throats.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, what about herbal tea?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's good for your throat, and goes great with apple pies!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's not a bad idea.
Plus, it's really soothing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. And this place's cafe sells herbal tea, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
They do!
We should be able to get some to go!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Then, we can also buy some tea.
What else is good for your throat? Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Come to think of it, does Tsukasa do anything special for his throat?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. I figured that he takes good care of his throat since he needs it when he performs in shows.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... I've never really asked him...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But I think he does stuff!
He's always doing everything he can, so I have to believe he's taking good care of his throat!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's certainly my image of him.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Although, I feel like he can shout at will without really doing anything special.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha♪ I'll send him a message since he might know some good tips and tricks.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks.
Then, while we wait for him to respond, let's buy everything else.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I hope we're able to help make their reading event a success.

rows.Speaker: Shiho & Saki
rows.Line:
Me too.
Me too!
